article.title: The Left Needs to Revisit Spirituality and History: Lessons from Walter Benjamin
article.author: Christopher Impiglia
article.content: As the Left, epitomized by the Democratic Socialists of America, resurges and Marxist thought returns to the fore as a real force, not simply as a bogeyman; as the midterms loom and, through them, we get our first taste of the 2028 Presidential election, I revisit Walter Benjamin, specifically his Theses on the Philosophy of History. Throughout this piece, Roman numerals are used to indicate each… Source
